problem: Consider a matrix equation $A\,x={B}^{-1}\,d,$ where $A$ and $B$ are $2\times 2$ non-singular matrices, while $x$ and $d$ are $2\times 1$ column vectors. Solve the equation for $x.$

feedback.problem: Consider a matrix equation ${A}^{-1}\,x=B\,d,$ where $A$ and $B$ are $7\times 7$ non-singular matrices, while $x$ and $d$ are $7\times 1$ column vectors. Solve the equation for $x.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Pre-multiplying both sides of the equation ${A}^{-1}\,x=B\,d$ by $A,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1}\,x & =B\,d \\ A{A}^{-1}\,x & =AB\,d \\ {I}_{7}\,x & =AB\,d \\ x & =AB\,d.\end{aligned}
$$
